timeline_semantics: Independent recorded samples; frame t is a browsing coordinate, not synchronized sensor time.

provenance.selection: Five curated diagnostic records; not a representative performance sample.

experiments.name: Frequency augmentation
experiments.note: Synthetic robustness improved, external recall declined.

experiments.name: Historical fold-selected rate correction
experiments.note: Historical grouped experiment: 394 valid windows; 22 large errors. Not the current fixed estimator.

experiments.name: Rate reliability screen
experiments.note: Historical fold-selected estimator; reliability gate failed safety and remains disabled.

experiments.name: Unified fixed rate estimator
experiments.note: Fixed boundary0 rule for everyone; 19 large errors. Previously observed development data, not independent validation.

streaming.provenance: Backend BreathingStream; virtual 250ms delivery. Simulated mode discards packets at 12–15s. Extra replay time allows the final real interpolation bracket to arrive, then demonstrates 2s input timeout. No live device.

csi_bench.selection: First three assessable IDs per class in lexicographic order; selection before inference, not score-filtered.
csi_bench.timing: 300 stored samples at nominal 30 Hz; original packet timestamps unavailable. Independent 10s samples, not continuous streaming.
csi_bench.limitations: Previously observed official test; illustrative examples, not a new holdout or performance estimate. No reference respiration or 30s rate estimate. No threshold/model changes.

fan_experience.selection: First assessable sample ID per device/scenario/class; selection before score inspection, not prediction correctness.
fan_experience.limitations: Observed U23/E09 test subset, not independent external validation. LOS fan-on empty class missing. No respiratory-rate reference. Different records, not paired on/off captures.

rate_estimator.rule: exact search endpoint only; preserve interior and no-local-peak outputs
